infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a selfie to preview lip colors and lashes on your device. Esha does not upload your selfie.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Esha’s voice conversations use only your microphone. Esha does not use your camera.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Esha uses your microphone when you start a voice conversation. Korlix and OpenAI process your audio and conversation to answer you.
